		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 9097 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 }
			debug_log = "ZG361WE RED: history-accruing conservation failed; AL remains active"
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_portfolio_terminal_history_accruing var:zg361_we_portfolio_terminal_history_accruing = 1 var:zg361_we_portfolio_closed = 1 var:zg361_we_portfolio_status = 8 var:zg361_case_al_active = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 2 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 9097 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } }
}

zg361_we_after_m360_history_gate_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_status
	remove_variable = zg361_we_adapter_blocked_reason
	save_scope_as = zg361_we_history_gate_subject
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_al_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_al_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_al_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_al_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_al_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_al_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_al_owner EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
				EXPECTED_STATE = 5
			}
			var:zg361_case_al_owner = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count >= 1
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count <= 3
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_owner = this
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_subject = scope:zg361_we_history_gate_subject
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_cycle = scope:zg361_we_history_gate_subject.var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
				var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_last_case = scope:zg361_we_history_gate_subject.var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:zg361_case_al_owner = {
					var:zg361_we_completed_cycle_ledger_count = 3
					trigger_if = { limit = { exists = liege } NOT = { liege = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
					trigger_else = { always = yes }
				}
			}
			zg361_we_prepare_m361_charter_evidence_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_al_owner TICKET_SUBJECT = this
				TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = { var:zg361_we_adapter_status = 1 var:zg361_we_adapter_status = 2 }
					has_variable = zg361_we_m361_evidence_ready
					var:zg361_we_m361_evidence_ready = 1
					var:zg361_we_m361_evidence_owner = var:zg361_case_al_owner
					var:zg361_we_m361_evidence_subject = this
					var:zg361_we_m361_evidence_cycle = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
					var:zg361_we_m361_evidence_case = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
				}
				zg361_we_al_schedule_stage_05_deadline_effect = yes
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_case_al_owner = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
					zg361_we_m361_route_a_effect = {
						TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_al_owner TICKET_SUBJECT = this
						TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_al_cycle_serial TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_al_case_serial
					}
				}
			}
			else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 3613 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } }
		}
		else = { zg361_we_finalize_history_accruing_effect = yes }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 3614 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } }
}
